_comment: Reference only — shows every allowed value. Not read by the script; fill in local-seed-data.json instead. Use the top-level 'orgs' array (this shape) to seed several organizations in one run — one per institution type, or as many as you like. A single { org, admin, employees } object (no 'orgs' wrapper) still works too, for seeding just one.

orgs._employees_notes: employees is optional — use an empty array [] to seed only the org + admin. Each is created as a regular (baseline) employee with no department or role — the org admin assigns those from within the app, since department/head-of-department roles depend on the department actually existing there first. level is free text, optional, and can be left empty.
